scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && uv sync --directory backend --locked
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend "uv run --directory backend --no-sync uvicorn src.api:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 --no-access-log" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 5143"
